scalars.scalar_value: 5 years of increasingly responsible administrative experience.

items.item_text: 5 years of increasingly responsible administrative experience.

Schedules meetings, making adjustments as necessary; posts and maintains appointment calendars; prepares confirmations, agendas and materials; makes room/food arrangements and does follow-up work as required.

Attend all assigned meetings. In preparation of assigned meetings will accurately prepare the agenda, during the meeting take accurate minutes and distribute to appropriate team members within 1 business week of the meeting, complete follow-up on all action items in an appropriate and timely manner. Accurately file and route documents.

Screens and distributes incoming correspondence, handles and advises supervisor of action taken or prioritizes and arranges with pertinent materials and notation of necessary action to be taken attached.
Screens a variety of calls and visitors and, where appropriate, refers them to other staff members or personally provides information based upon established program and policy issues.
Maintains comprehensive Administrative, Subject and Contract Files.
Reviews and screens invoices; tracks expenditures and purchases to assure adherence to budget. Assists other administrators and their support staff as needed.
